scripts.title: Peppino Mach run
scripts.script:
local speedTool = Instance.new("Tool")
speedTool.Name = "SpeedTool"
speedTool.RequiresHandle = false

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local function onActivated()
    character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100 --
end

local function onUnequipped()
    character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16 -- Set 
end

speedTool.Activated:Connect(onActivated)
speedTool.Unequipped:Connect(onUnequipped)
speedTool.Parent = player.Backpack local superJumpTool = Instance.new("Tool")
superJumpTool.Name = "SuperJumpTool"
superJumpTool.RequiresHandle = false

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local function onActivated()
    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 100, 0)
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
    bodyVelocity.Parent = character.HumanoidRootPart

    
    bodyVelocity:Destroy()
end

superJumpTool.Activated:Connect(onActivated)
superJumpTool.Parent = player.Backpack
